overall: The AG found the Swansea School Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the chair's failure to re-send the complaint was harmless, and the two unlisted statements were not topics the chair anticipated discussing.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee chair failed to follow proper procedure in responding to an OML complaint by not disseminating copies of the complaint to all members.
allegations.key_passage: While it is true that the chair did not disseminate copies of the complaint to all Committee members, doing so would have been redundant, since all members had already received the complaint by e-mail.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the April 25 notice failed to list member Carvalho's discussion with the superintendent about a property purchase as an anticipated topic.
allegations.key_passage: Chair Graham stated that he did not anticipate the statement from Mr, Carvalho regarding the property discussions, and we credit this statement.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice failed to list the chair's announcement promoting the high school production of South Pacific as an anticipated topic.
allegations.key_passage: Rather, this was an innocuous comment made in passing, and not a piece of business that chair anticipated the Committee would discuss.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
